data_role: post-hoc diagnosis of already viewed fixed-objective search failures
selection: Three exhausted searches with eight valid candidates, plus the one invalid-sampling search as a domain control; no outcome-based new sample selection
anchor: Exactly the archived final poses, original initial population/normalizers, original incoming prior and full guarded Gauss-Newton proposal; never reselect at the final poses
multipliers: Both signs of 2^-e for all integer exponents0..20, including every original search candidate; no adaptive extension after seeing results
measurements: Full objective, per-source Huber loss difference summed with math.fsum, prior difference, signed secants, central secant, endpoint interpolation-cell changes and pixel displacement
numerics: Record original Armijo decisions both with its existing1e-12 max(1,abs(cost)) slack and without slack; tiny accepted steps alone do not establish descent or convergence. Paired residual differences reduce total-cost cancellation but are not certified error bounds
independent_validation: Separate SVD image surfaces, initial relative-camera selector, polynomial inverse-depth sampler, incidence/prior system, Cholesky solve, Rodrigues increments and homogeneous projection; compare every objective, loss partition and cell count. Shared aggregation is not an independent implementation of the whole diagnostic
analytic_controls: Authored smooth-cell, exact grid-knot and invalid-sampling fixtures exercise directional slopes, one-sided differences and no cost after lost support; their injected directions are not solver proposals or physical accuracy evidence
scope: Read-only probes only: no optimizer continuation, accepted pose, new convergence, numeric ground truth, trajectory fitting, tracker/prior commits, guard relaxation or default change
